text: They just add more stuff into the old stew. Grains, roots, random vegetables, maybe a bean,
maybe a pebble. Whatever fell in the pot. The stew is older than most people in the room.
Potage was the main food for most peasants in medieval Europe. People ate some version of it
almost every day. Your spoon is a stick that someone carved with a knife. They also used
yesterday to castrate a goat. Hygiene was not invented yet. Next to the bowl, you get a piece
of bread. Not soft bread. No. This bread is a medieval weapon. You could literally crack
someone's skull with it. This bread is harder than your will to live. It's made of cheap
flour mixed with random filler like sawdust, bark, or powdered grass. You soak it in the
stew until it softens enough that your teeth stand a chance. And sometimes, the flour itself
